content.short: Synthetix Subgraph provides a GraphQL API to query on-chain data from the Synthetix protocol.
content.description: Synthetix Subgraph provides a GraphQL API endpoint that queries on-chain data from Synthetix smart contracts. It surfaces price feeds, exchange rates, Total Value Locked, volumes per Synth, and additional related metrics, enabling structured access to both historical and current state data. By indexing and organizing this information, the Subgraph supports analyzing user behavior, monitoring protocol dynamics, and building new applications that interact with the Synthetix protocol.
